summary: A caller-supplied, non-disk-backed IDxcIncludeHandler's content is never what gets embedded as an included file's SPIR-V DebugSource text (-fspv-debug=vulkan-with-source): EmitVisitor.cpp's ReadSourceCode always does its own independent raw disk read instead of reusing the buffer the handler already returned to the parser. Measured with a purpose-built API harness (handler4805.cpp, registered as compiler main-debug-inc4805) since dxc.exe's CLI can never supply a custom handler at all. Three scenarios isolate it cleanly: repro.hlsl (no disk file backs the include) compiles S_OK with the marker absent (the reported defect); control-identical (byte-identical disk file at the resolved path) compiles S_OK with the marker present, proving the harness/API/byte-search all work; control-mismatch (a real but differently-formatted file at the same path) now FAILS compilation outright on main-debug with a SPIR-V validator rejection -- a newly-found, worse failure mode absent on v1.7.2207 (2022, contemporary with filing) and v1.8.2502 (2025-02), bounded by git merge-base to PR #7662 (97b5edbc4, merged 2025-07-24). The literal 2022 crash does not reproduce on any build tested; today's shape (silent content loss, no crash) matches the second commenter leozzyzheng's 2025-11-19 report more closely than the original body. DXIL (-Zi -Qembed_debug) was checked but the byte-search instrument's own positive control failed there (DXIL's debug source is not a contiguous ASCII run), so it is left unmeasured, not asserted either way. Godbolt explicitly skipped: CE's dxc panes cannot supply a custom IDxcIncludeHandler at all.
text_stale: The body describes a crash under -Zi/-fspv-debug=source with CWD=parent-dir; this no longer reproduces as a crash on any build tested (the disk-read failure has been wrapped in a non-crashing catch since 2020, predating the report). The underlying 'handler ignored' defect the title names is still fully real and unfixed -- only the reported symptom's shape (crash vs silent content loss) is stale. leozzyzheng's 2025-11-19 comment already reflects the current, non-crashing shape.
title: Compiler does not use the custom include handler when compiling with `-Zi`
